date_note: Both pages (STA wire, 26 November) give no earlier day; the employee's check is described as around noon, without a date.
title: Refrigeration units at Kmetijska zadruga Tolmin's Salamerija Alpija hit by cyberattack, STA reports
geo_basis: town named in the article (Tolmin); coordinates approximate
summary: Slovenian news agency STA reports that unknown attackers changed the temperature settings of several refrigerators and chambers at Salamerija Alpija, part of Kmetijska zadruga Tolmin; a freezer chamber was set to 100 degrees Celsius. Cooperative director Nikola Šavle told 24ur.com staff noticed in time and prevented damage. He says all cooling systems were disconnected from the network and the incident will be reported to SI-CERT.
plain: Unknown attackers changed the settings of refrigerators at a Slovenian meat producer. The cooperative's director says staff noticed in time and no damage was done.
exec: Cooling systems at a Slovenian food producer were tampered with. The cooperative says staff prevented damage and disconnected the systems from the network.

evidence.quote: Zaposleni so napad pravočasno zaznali in preprečili škodo.
temperatura v zamrzovalni komori nastavljena na 100 stopinj Celzija

validation.note: Both pages are the same STA wire report (RTV Slovenija, Primorske novice), so one publisher; the director's statement is quoted via 24ur.com, which was not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: only one freezer chamber was stated at 100 C (others 20 C); summary now says settings changed, one chamber at 100 degrees; director's statement attributed to 24ur
